evidence: The pl-O2-Al2O3 and H2O-Al2O3 films were deposited with trimethylaluminum (TMA) at a wafer temperature of 350°C prior to HfO2 layer deposition by an ALD technique using a traveling-wave type ALD reactor. The O3-Al2O3 films were grown using another ALD system with TMA and O3 as the precursor and oxidant, respectively, at a wafer temperature of 400°C.
